{{Quote|Only three percent ever leave this institution. We take quite extreme cases after all.|Doctor S. Pelbion|<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Valorum Center''' was a judicial psychiatric unit located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that housed patients who were only a danger to themselves. It contained the [[Hesperidium Wing]].<ref name="o66" />

It was there where [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ovolot Qail Uthan]] was held in isolation for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before finally being rescued by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Bardan Jusik]], [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], [[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and [[Kal Skirata]].<ref name="o66" />
